content:
anjali_pm: Quick sync 94 ACME Cloud + EdgeCore asked if we can offer a downloadable quantized bundle in their marketplace. They need clarity on allowed recipients, license flow, and whether Redwood will host mirrors. @dave_legal any legal red flags?

kai_ops: Hosting vs downloads is a big ops delta. Downloads => signed manifest, checksums, geo-blocking, and we have to decide who pays mirror/egress. Hosting behind API avoids a lot of surface.

sam_eng: Technical constraints: our supported runtime formats are q4_0, q4_k, and fp16. Bundles must include exact tokenizer + vocab. Suggest manifest schema like:
```
sha256: abcd1234ef5678...
format: ggml/q4_0
tokenizer: v1
compatible_runtime: rdx-runtime-v2
```
If partner allows quantization, we need permission to publish transformed artifacts (quantized/pruned).

lisa_marketing: Heads-up on comms: don't promise "on-prem ready" unless Dedicated certs are done. Also we need an embargo window for the joint blog/demo at EdgeCore summit.

dave_legal: Legal baseline: prefer hosting-only on marketplace. If partner insists on downloadable bundles require a redistribution addendum with: indemnity, export-control warranty (EAR/ITAR compliance), provenance attestation, and express permission to distribute derivatives (quantized/optimized builds). Also need partner to confirm upstream license (Apache-2.0, MIT, CC-BY, etc.) and any CLA/third-party component obligations.

anjali_pm: Two clarifying Qs for partner: 1) Do they permit creation and redistribution of transformed artifacts (quantized/optimized)? 2) Are there countries to geo-block for downloads?

dave_legal: Draft clause suggestion: "Partner hereby grants Redwood a non-exclusive license to create, host, and, subject to execution of a Redistribution Addendum, distribute derivative artifacts (including quantized and hardware-optimized variants) to Redwood customers. Redistribution outside Redwood-managed offerings requires prior written consent. Partner warrants export-control compliance and provides provenance attestations for training data and bundled third-party components."

sam_eng: If we include EdgeCore-optimized binaries in the bundle, require a build-provenance file and signed checksum. Also call out tokenizer/version pin.

kai_ops: Operational asks: manifest + checksum must be signed by partner; we enforce per-SKU region allowlist; downloads increase incident surface (corruption, partial pulls) so include retry guidance and md5/sha verification in packaging. Also estimate of egress cost needed.

lisa_marketing: Announcement copy proposal (neutral): "Model X available via Redwood on ACME Cloud marketplace. EdgeCore-optimized artifact available subject to partner distribution terms." Avoid benchmarking claims unless we have third-party sign-off.

anjali_pm: Action items:
- @dave_legal: draft Redistribution Addendum template (due Fri EOD)
- @sam_eng: draft manifest schema + example tools (due Wed)
- @kai_ops: egress + mirror cost estimate and geo-block enforcement steps (due Thu)
- @lisa_marketing: draft announcement copy and embargo timeline (due Tue)

deploy-bot: [task created] marketplace-quantized-bundle-checklist assigned to anjali_pm,dave_legal,sam_eng,kai_ops,lisa_marketing due 2025-06-01

anjali_pm: I'll loop in the partner and schedule a 30m sync for Friday 10am PT. Thanks all :pray:
